transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you into the clinic?

Hi. Well, what brought me in is... I keep hearing this voice. It's a man's voice. I hear it at the shop, coming from the garage vents, and sometimes right out from under the hood of the cars I'm working on. 

It's as clear as somebody standing right next to me. He just keeps telling me not to trust my husband, and... he tells me not to touch certain cars. I just needed to come in and talk to someone about it.
About how long have you been hearing this voice?
It's been going on for about ten months now. That's when the voice started. And... well, that's also around the time I started realizing I was being tracked, too. So, about ten months for all of it.
During these past ten months, have you had times where you felt deeply depressed or down?

No, not really. I mean, I haven't felt deeply depressed or anything like that. I've just been dealing with the voice and the tracking, but my mood itself has been pretty normal, I guess. I haven't felt down.
Do you use any recreational drugs, alcohol, or non-prescribed medications?
No, I don't use any drugs or anything like that. I'll have a beer every now and then, but that's about it. No pills or anything that isn't prescribed to me.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or physical illnesses?
No, I haven't. I don't have any physical health problems or medical conditions. I'm pretty healthy in that way, actually.
